svg.title: VYNN AI: how the platform fits together
svg.desc: You sign in to the app with Google or GitHub, or arrive as a guest from a question on vynnai.com, and ask in the chat. The API checks who is asking and starts a job: each analysis runs in its own container of the agent, pinned by image digest. The agent pulls published data, reasons with OpenAI or Anthropic, computes every number in code and checks it with its guardrails. The run's report, workbook, sources and log land in the user's folder. Progress streams to the chat, then the answer arrives with a cited PDF report and an Excel model, and is kept as a dated thesis on the dashboard. The API serves prices and company data from its cache and keeps theses, portfolios and conversations per user.
